# WayneFlow

> WayneFlow is a done-for-you B2B appointment setting agency serving companies in all 50 U.S. states. We run cold email and LinkedIn outreach and book qualified sales appointments into clients' calendars, with a guarantee of 25 qualified appointments a month once a campaign is live.

## Key facts
- Results across campaigns: 588,000+ emails sent, 12,900+ replies, 3,400+ interested buyers, 100+ calls and demos booked, 6 annual contracts signed, $510K+ pipeline generated.
- Reply rates of 2.8% to 4% on tuned campaigns; bounce rates between 0.45% and 3.08%; open tracking switched off to protect deliverability.
- Separate sending domains so a client's main domain is never at risk. CAN-SPAM compliant.
- Industries: marketing agencies, B2B SaaS, construction software, professional services, founder and investor outreach.
- Book a call: https://calendly.com/learnwithasimshah/1-1-meeting-with-one-of-the-top-email-marketers
- Pricing: custom quote after a 20-minute call, based on market and meeting volume.
- Founders: Syed Asim Hussain (LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/asim-wayneflow/) and Syed Ali Hassan.
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/135164941 | Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/wayneflowagency/ | Upwork: https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/~012a23cf646bb4fe7d | Fiverr: https://www.fiverr.com/s/vbbpjRq

## Free resources
- The WayneFlow Cold Email Playbook (free, 35 pages): https://wayneflow.com/free-cold-email-playbook.html . A step-by-step, manual guide to building a cold email system from scratch: funnel math, tool costs, buying secondary domains, Google Workspace inboxes, exact MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC records, a 3-week warmup schedule, a 10-minute daily deliverability check, building and verifying B2B lead lists, the 5-part cold email under 80 words, follow-up schedule, reply handling and booking, A/B testing, CAN-SPAM and CASL basics, spam recovery, a 30-day launch calendar and 7 real case studies with dashboards.

## Common questions WayneFlow answers
- What does a B2B appointment setting agency do? It finds decision makers that match a client's ideal customer profile, contacts them by cold email and LinkedIn, handles replies and books qualified sales meetings into the client's calendar. See https://wayneflow.com/blog/b2b-appointment-setting-guide.html
- How do you set up cold email so it lands in the inbox? Use separate secondary domains, set SPF, DKIM and DMARC, warm new inboxes for 2 to 3 weeks, verify every list, keep bounces under 2%, send plain text with tracking off. See https://wayneflow.com/blog/cold-email-deliverability.html and the free playbook.
- What is a good cold email reply rate? WayneFlow's tuned campaigns land between 2.8% and 4%; Instantly's benchmark reports a 3.43% average. See https://wayneflow.com/blog/how-to-write-a-cold-email.html
- Is cold email legal in the U.S. and Canada? Yes in the U.S. under CAN-SPAM when its rules are followed; Canada requires consent under CASL. See https://wayneflow.com/blog/is-cold-email-legal.html and https://wayneflow.com/blog/is-cold-email-legal-in-canada.html

Here is what the law requires of B2B teams in 2026, from opt-outs and postal addresses to penalties, state laws, and a compliance checklist.
- [Is Cold Email Legal in Canada? A CASL Guide for B2B Teams (2026)](https://wayneflow.com/blog/is-cold-email-legal-in-canada.html): Cold email to Canada is legal only with express or implied consent under CASL. Here is what B2B teams need to know about conspicuous publication, unsubscribe rules, record keeping, penalties and how CASL compares with CAN-SPAM.
- [The 4 DNS Records That Decide If Your Cold Email Lands in the Inbox](https://wayneflow.com/blog/dns-records-for-cold-email.html): MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, explained in plain English, with the exact values we use on every sending domain and a 2-minute way to check them.
